clips.text: Your AI is only as good as your prompt.
Build a prompt that sorts our support emails into billing, bugs, and feature requests.
It asks smart follow-up questions. Out loud.
Which emails are hardest to label? One, billing versus refunds. Two, bugs that sound like feature asks. Three, emails with several issues.
No clicks. Every question builds on your last answer.
Then it picks the right prompting technique.
Don't like the result? Tell it what's wrong.
It rewrites the prompt, and remembers for next time.
Then drops it right into ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.
It never hits send. You stay in control.
Voice Prompt Builder. Think aloud. Prompt precisely.
